title: Urutonde rwo kwisuzuma – Shimi y'ibiryo
subject: Kemi
intro: Uru rutonde rukurikiza intambwe enye z'ingenzi z'igitabo cyo kwiga. Shyira akamenyetso ku byo wumva ufitiye icyizere.

sections.title: 1. Karubohidarati (M1)
items: Nshobora gutanga ingero eshatu za karubohidarati.
Nzi ibintu fatizo (elementi) karubohidarati zikozwemo.
Nshobora gusobanura itandukaniro riri hagati ya monosakaridi, disakaridi na polisakaridi.
Nzi ko glucose, fructose na galactose byose bifite formile C6H12O6 ariko bikozwe mu buryo butandukanye.
Nzi ko sakarozi ari izina rya shimi ry'isukari isanzwe, kandi nzi icyo ikozwemo.
Nshobora gusobanura aho Umuti w'ibirebana na Herufi bisa n'aho batandukanira.
Nzi impamvu umubiri w'umuntu udashobora gukura ingufu muri Herufi.
Nshobora gutanga ingero z'ibiryo birimo Umuti w'ibirebana byinshi.

sections.title: 2. Amavuta (M2)
items: Nshobora gushushanya/gusobanura uko molekile y'amavuta yubatswe (glycerol + aside y'amavuta eshatu).
Nzi icyo amavuta akoreshwa mu mubiri.
Nzi alukoli ijya buri gihe mu amavuta (glycerol).
Nshobora gusobanura itandukaniro riri hagati y'amavuta yuzuye n'amavuta adakwiye kwuzura hakurikijwe umubare w'imikoranire ikubye kabiri.
Nzi ko amavuta afite ingufu zirenga incuro ebyiri ku igiramu ugereranyije na karubohidarati.
Nzi icyo ari cyo amavuta yakomejwe (härdat fett).

sections.title: 3. Poroteyine (M3)
items: Nzi icyo poroteyine ikozwemo (aside amine).
Nshobora gutanga urugero rumwe rwa poroteyine kuri buri mikorere: ibikoresho by'ubwubatsi, imikorere y'imikaya, enzyme, hormone.
Nzi ko enzyme ari poroteyine.
Nshobora gusobanura (nta formile y'imiterere) uko aside amine ziri mu murongo zizinga kugira ngo zigire imiterere ya poroteyine.
Nshobora gusobanura icyo aside amine ngombwa ari cyo.
Nshobora gusobanura ibibaho igihe poroteyine igizwe mu buryo bundi (denatured), urugero, n'ubushyuhe.

sections.title: 4. Incamake, vitamine na mineral (M4)
items: Nshobora gusobanura uko ibimera (Umuti w'ibirebana) n'inyamaswa (glycogen) bibika ingufu.
Nzi mu buryo bworoshye icyo vitamine na mineral bikoreshwa, n'ubwoko bw'ibiryo aho biboneka.
Nshobora gusobanura uko umubiri ukoresha karubohidarati, amavuta na poroteyine hamwe.
